_comment: The cmux NEXT PR fast tier (scripts/cmux-next/fast-tier.py, hq#1980, cx-7cwo). Every feat-cmux-next PR runs deterministic Rust entries on Blacksmith Linux; web and typecheck remain the existing Linux ci-web checks. Swift, size and crash ratchets run on the full-ci batched integration branch. An entry is deterministic (fixed seeds, virtual clock, no sleeps), needs no window server or daemon process, runs within 60 s after the build, and names a stable ID in each failure line.
